results.title: Resurrecting the Night
results.overview: The Film explores the inner world of artist Ma Wei-a small town-scene trapped in eternal night. Initially, there were only dull spectators, flat characters and Ma Wei herself, paralyzed by a creative crisis. Everything changes when her own creation, He Ling, gains free will. Between the creator and the work begins a fascinating struggle. Through the collision of illusion and hard reality, he Ling breaks the narrative shackles, and Ma Wei undergoes spiritual liberation, embarking on a new artistic journey.

results.title: DEADLINE
results.overview: In a crowded waiting room, a nervous young man watches other people around him talk vaguely about some kind of deadline. A secretary calls them in one by one.

results.title: Miracle Whip
results.overview: Sebastian Winterfold (Michael Louis Hassiepen) applies for the job of a lifetime.

results.title: A Christmas Destiny
results.overview: Five years after one unforgettable Christmas Eve together, Serena and Jarrod cross paths again, except now, they’ve both moved on, and neither one is single.

results.title: Trapiá, Um Outro Sertão
results.overview: In the heart of the hinterlands of Paraíba, in Northeast Brazil, trapiá is the name of a tree that defies both the sun and the drought. This documentary portrays a rural community in the midst of a transition away from a traditional way of life. Its subjects endure the setbacks of existence: stories of heartbreak and loneliness, but also of joy and resilience.

results.title: Caso Isolado
results.overview: Following an accident involving a delivery worker at her workplace, Cristina - a light-skinned Black woman - begins delivering cosmetics in João Pessoa. As she moves through the city, everyday encounters reveal tensions surrounding racial perception, a sense of belonging, and colorism in contemporary Brazil.

results.overview: A brand new documentary exploring the edits, omissions and creative changes made when transforming the original episodes into movie form.

results.overview: A brand new documentary exploring the edits, omissions and creative changes made when transforming the original episodes into movie form.

results.title: OJ’s Accomplice
results.overview: While the world was distracted by the media circus around O.J. Simpson's trial, they might have ignored a chilling possibility: he may have had help.

results.title: O Homem Para o Tempo
results.overview: In Ouro Preto, longing stirs the scene anew. It weaves memory across the fissures of time. Desire is reborn, vibrant and alive - a city set amidst resonant, enigmatic machines. Fragments of affection, time, desire, and place.

results.title: De Barriga Pra Cima
results.overview: Here in Monte Alegre, we dream of land, we dream of water, of the sky; we dream of things that exist and things that do not yet exist. A film created as part of a cinema workshop in the *quilombola* community of Monte Alegre, in Cachoeiro de Itapemirim, Espírito Santo.

results.title: Cabeceira
results.overview: After being kicked out of the house by her mother, Rita returns to find her younger sister, Chica, all alone. Together, they set out for a walk through a landscape marked by loneliness and a lack of prospects.

results.title: Amargô
results.overview: Amargô is a dark fable about a seamstress who returns to her hometown, seeking to reconnect with her daughter, only to find a place consumed by poisonous memories.

results.title: Redamar
results.overview: Ulisses spends his days in a monotonous routine, longing for something that will never come: love. At night, in Fortaleza, he seeks to fulfill his repressed desires and frustrations, but his life begins to change when he receives news of his mother’s death in the distant neighborhood of Baleia.

results.title: Escape Routes
results.overview: Adapted from a short story by Lucy Caldwell. In 1990s Belfast, a lonely young girl becomes entranced by her teenage babysitter, who introduces her to the computer game ‘Zork’ and a brief, bright world of secret codes, imagination, and escape.

results.title: The Standard
results.overview: The world’s most popular bodybuilding champion wrestles with the emotional and physical cost of his final competition, and the question of who he will be once it’s all over.

results.title: Blood Money
results.overview: After a robbery goes wrong, Ali reunites with his partner Mike in a desrt street to await their contact. But when an unexpected revelation throws their reunion into question, Ali finds himself caught in a nightmarish situation.

results.title: La Muerte Es Renacer
results.overview: "La Muerte Es Renacer" is about inner story from Latin Culture.

results.title: The Bride
results.overview: Undead Elizabeth searches for her husband, for whom she was crafted.

results.title: Grub Explains Portsmouth
results.overview: Portsmouth legend "Grub" lets you know what's going on round here.
